final: WITH d AS (SELECT event_status, (amount - spent) AS diff FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL AND spent IS NOT NULL), b AS (SELECT AVG(diff) AS base FROM d) SELECT d.event_status, AVG(d.diff) AS avg_diff, AVG(d.diff) - b.base AS diff_from_baseline FROM d, b WHERE b.base IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.event_status
